answer: Malicious File Upload works by allowing an adversary to upload a file that can be executed on the server. This typically occurs when the adversary discovers a directory with executable permissions and uploads a malicious file to that location. Once uploaded, the adversary can either execute the malicious file directly or exploit an existing misconfigured file that allows executable access. This can be done through various methods, such as using a misconfigured FTP server to facilitate the upload [Source 1][Source 2].
